name: GET /api/auth/verification-status - email verification state for an address

testCases.name: Freshly-registered address exists but is not yet verified
Unknown address reports exists=false rather than 404

description: Reports whether an email address is known to the system and whether it has completed email verification. Public and additive by design: it never gates register, signup or login — the UI calls it to decide whether to prompt the user to request a fresh verification email. An unknown address is NOT an error; it returns 200 with exists=false so the endpoint cannot be used to distinguish 'no account' from 'server error'. verified is derived from whether the stored person row has a non-null verified_at.

errorCases.when: The email query parameter is absent, empty, or not a string
